clusters.pick_reason: CI is unknown for both. On diff size, #1786 (4 files) is smaller than #1912 (7 files), and #1786 is older — both criteria favor #1786. However, #1786 carries an "[RFC]" prefix, explicitly marking it as a Request for Comments / proposal rather than a finished implementation; RFC-tagged PRs are conventionally not merge-ready. #1912 has no such qualifier and its larger file count (7 vs 4) is more likely to include test coverage. The approach in #1912 — a focused `replayInitialization` method for stateless serverless sessions — is also more narrowly scoped to the reported issue, whereas #1786 frames the change as broad "multi-node session hydration" with C# SDK parity goals that go beyond the original bug report. Given that implementation completeness outweighs diff size when one PR is explicitly a draft proposal, #1912 is the stronger candidate.
